mainEntity.name: Is Christopher W. Burns still wanted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. As of October 15, 2026, he is listed on the FBI Most Wanted Fraudsters page with a reward of up to $150,000.

mainEntity.name: When was Christopher W. Burns last seen?

acceptedAnswer.text: September 24, 2020, when he left his home in Georgia. His vehicle was later found abandoned in Dunwoody, GA.

mainEntity.name: What activity appears after that date?

acceptedAnswer.text: A Google Maps contributor account allegedly attributed to Burns shows a review at PrimoHoagies in Wayne, PA ("5 years ago," ~2021) and a rating at Target in Wynnewood, PA ("3 years ago," ~2023), both after September 24, 2020.
Wayne is his FBI-listed place of birth, and the addresses, employer, and Maps activity in his identifier graph all cluster in the Wayne / Main Line area.
Activity on the Main Line roughly one and three years after he vanished in Georgia, pointing to a return to his home region. The ~2023 rating is the stronger data point.
